rows.text: with `w` = `rcx`, `b` = qword `+0x378` of qword `[0209AC30]` and `t` = qword `[b+0x20]` + 0x30, picks the 8-byte record `e` = `t` + word `[t+0x10]` + 8*`k`, `k` = word `[t+0x18+2*word [t+0x18]]`; fills stack rectangles `A` = (word `[e]`, word `[e+2]`, word `[e+4]` AND 0xFFF, (dword `[e+4]` >> 12) AND 0xFFF) and `B` = (`dx`, `r8w`, the same two masked values); stores to byte `[w+0x5C]` byte `[t + word [t+0x12] + (byte [e+7] >> 4)]` + (byte `[e+7]` AND 0xF) (`t` re-read); then calls `002D8BB0(w, 1)`, `002D8C80(w, b, &A, &B)` and `002D8BB0(w, 0)`; returns nothing

with `g` = qword `[0209AC30]` and `d` = qword `[g+0x2E0]`: when `d` is null it creates `d` = `00244F50(0x170, 002CBF80, &a)` with the stack argument block `a` = (dword 0, `rcx`, qword 0), stores it to `[g+0x2E0]` and calls `00246AD0(qword [0208EA28], d)`; for an existing `d` it makes that call only when byte `[d+0x7C]` has `0x20`; stack cookie `01F44830`, checked by `00808C40`

returns `ecx` unchanged when byte `+0xDEC` of qword `[0209AC30]` is non-zero; otherwise returns trunc(`sinf`(`x` * 3.141593 / `q`) * `edx` + `ecx`) in single precision, where `x` is dword `[0208F570]` - `r8d` taken as an unsigned 32-bit value, `q` = 60 / `r9d` (signed integer division, then converted) and the call is the CRT `sinf` thunk `00861F0E`

returns the value of `00280120()` (incoming registers passed through) when it is non-zero; otherwise reads five values `v1`..`v5` in turn with `00267E10(r9)` and returns `002D78B0(v5, v4, v3, v2, v1)`

returns the value of `00280120()` when it is non-zero; otherwise, with `b` = `002640C0()`, takes four out-pointers `p1`..`p4` = `002650B0(b, rcx, 00267E10(r9))` in turn, then `x` and `y` from `00267E10(r9)`, calls `00568460(y, x, &w, 0)` for a stack block of four words `w`, and stores them sign-extended as dwords: `w[0]` to `*p4`, `w[1]` to `*p3`, `w[2]` to `*p2` and `w[3]` to `*p1`; returns `w[3]` sign-extended

with the entry `e` = `rcx` + (`r9d` + 7)*0x20 and the three objects `t`, `u`, `c` = qwords `+0`, `+8`, `+0x10` of qword `[rdx+0x10]` (re-read): qword `[t+0x18]` = qword `[e]`, dword `[t+0x20]` = `0020E620(0)`, `v` = `002DD7E0(2 when byte [e+0x10] is non-zero, else 0)` to dword `[t+0x24]`, and `0x1` cleared in dword `[t+8]` when word `[e+8]` is 0xFFFF; with `k` = byte `[e+0xA]`, byte `[u+0x39]` = byte `[qword [u+0x20] + 8k + 7]` and word `[u+0xA]` = `k`, and `0x1` cleared in dword `[u+8]` when word `[e+8]` is 0xFFFF or 0x96 or byte `[e+0x10]` is 0xF; dword `[c+0x24]` = `v`, words `[c+0xC]` = word `[qword [c]+4]` + 0x20 and `[c+0xE]` = word `[qword [c]+6]`; then calls `0029FF60(c, 0, 0, signed word [e+0xC], 0x465F, 0)` when byte `[e+0x11]` is non-zero, else clears `0x1` in dword `[c+8]`; returns 1

with the entry `e` = `rcx` + (`r9d` + 7)*0x20 and `t` = qword `[qword [rdx+0x10]]`: qword `[t+0x18]` = qword `[e]`, dword `[t+0x20]` = `0020E620(0)`, words `[t+0xC]` = word `[qword [t]+4]` - 0x12 and `[t+0xE]` = word `[qword [t]+6]`, dword `[t+0x24]` = `002DD7E0(2 when byte [e+0x10] is non-zero, else 0)`, and `0x1` cleared in dword `[t+8]` when word `[e+8]` is 0xFFFF; then clears `0x1` in dword `+8` of qword `+8` of qword `[rdx+0x10]` and returns 1
